title: Felix and the Wardrobe
author: M. M. Blackwood
blurb: Emrys Marchetti, a restaurant critic who has forgotten how food tastes, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. But when a song on the radio is one that was written and never recorded, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must say goodbye properly, at last, out loud, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
